newsitem.title: USA: MCI sets local calling service in Denver.
newsitem.headline: MCI sets local calling service in Denver.

text.p: MCI Communications Inc said Wednesday it introduced local calling service in the Greater Denver area, its first step in entering the Colorado telephone market.
It said the local service will be available to business customers in Denver-area communities, including Boulder.

It added that, later this year, pending completion of arbitrations with US West Communications, it plans to offer other local calling products to residential and business customers throughout the state.
Including Denver, MCI now offers local service over its own fiber optic networks and digital switching facilities in 20 major markets throughout the country.
The launching today follows MCI's announcement that it plans to merge with British Telecommunications Plc, creating a global telecommunications company.
